allow.reason: Opt-in split deployment only (SDKWORK_WEBSERVER_DRIVE_PROVIDER_MODE=http). The in-process Drive transport is the default and reads Drive's own website-root, resource-resolution and object-store ports on the shared PostgreSQL pool; this module builds the HTTP client only after that explicit opt-in, and startup fails closed when the endpoint or its ingress token file is missing.

Opt-in split deployment only (SDKWORK_WEBSERVER_KNOWLEDGEBASE_PROVIDER_MODE=http). The in-process transport is the default and calls Knowledgebase's own KnowledgeWikiPublicProviderService; this module builds the HTTP client only after that explicit opt-in, and startup fails closed when the endpoint or its ingress token file is missing.

Explicit HTTP opt-in, default is in-process, startup-validated. File-scoped entry for the second detection mode: HttpUsageIngestChannel posts the metering windows to the Deploy control-plane /backend/v3/api/usage/ingest endpoint, and is selected only by usageMetering.channel.mode=http with an absolute http(s) endpoint (config validation rejects a blank or relative one at startup). The default UsageMeteringChannel::Embedded writes the same UsageEventIngestItem batch through the shared Deploy database in-process, so a single-process deployment never constructs this channel.
